messages.content:
You are SOLVING a short quiz for children in grade 5, subject maths. You are NOT told which answers are right: work out every question yourself, the way a careful teacher who knows the subject would. The quiz is in Urdu; read it in that language, and judge spelling, letters, word forms and numbers exactly as they are written.

WHAT THE LESSON WAS ABOUT — context only. It tells you what the questions are about; a fact (a spelling, the letters of a word, a sum, a definition, a date) is decided by what is TRUE, not by this text.
Lesson summary: آج کے سبق میں حقیقی زندگی کے ایک مالیاتی مسئلے کو حل کرنے کا منصوبہ ہے: قیمت کو تعداد سے ضرب دے کر کل آمدنی معلوم کرنا، پھر ابتدائی اخراجات (investment) کو گھٹانا، اور آخر میں منافع کو شراکت داروں میں برابر تقسیم کرنا۔ اس میں بلال اور حرا کے 20 toffees کو 5.25 روپے فی toffee کے حساب سے بیچنے اور 40.00 روپے کے investment کے بعد منافع کا حساب شامل ہے۔
What the children were meant to learn:
- قیمت کو تعداد سے ضرب دے کر کل آمدنی معلوم کرنا۔
- کل آمدنی سے ابتدائی اخراجات (investment) کو گھٹا کر منافع معلوم کرنا۔
- منافع کو شراکت داروں میں برابر تقسیم کرنا۔
- اعشاریہ والے اعداد کو گھٹاتے وقت اعشاریہ کے نقطوں کو صحیح طریقے سے سیدھ میں لانا۔

THE QUESTIONS

q0 (one answer): کسی چیز کو بیچنے سے جو کل رقم حاصل ہوتی ہے اسے کیا کہتے ہیں؟
  options: [0] profit | [1] investment | [2] earnings

q1 (one answer): اگر ایک toffee کی قیمت Rs $5.25$ ہے تو 20 toffees کی کل earnings کتنی ہوگی؟
  options: [0] Rs $65.00$ | [1] Rs $40.00$ | [2] Rs $105.00$

q2 (one answer): اگر کل earnings Rs $105.00$ ہو اور investment کی رقم Rs $40.00$ ہو تو profit کتنا ہوگا؟
  options: [0] Rs $105.00$ | [1] Rs $65.00$ | [2] Rs $145.00$
  the picture the child sees, as data: {"type":"money","items":[{"value":100,"kind":"note"},{"value":5,"kind":"coin"},{"value":40,"kind":"note","count":1,"label":"investment"}]}
  check: options [0] and [2] differ by one letter — decide whether BOTH answer the question as asked

q3 (one answer): اگر بلال اور حرا کو Rs $65.00$ کا profit ہوا اور وہ اسے برابر تقسیم کرنا چاہیں تو ہر ایک کو کتنی رقم ملے گی؟
  options: [0] Rs $65.00$ | [1] Rs $32.50$ | [2] Rs $30.50$
  the picture the child sees, as data: {"type":"money","items":[{"value":50,"kind":"note"},{"value":10,"kind":"coin"},{"value":5,"kind":"coin"}],"group":2}
  check: options [1] and [2] differ by one letter — decide whether BOTH answer the question as asked

q4 (one answer): profit سے کیا مراد ہے؟
  options: [0] earnings میں سے investment گھٹانے کے بعد بچنے والی رقم | [1] کسی چیز کو بیچنے سے حاصل ہونے والی کل رقم | [2] وہ رقم جو کوئی کام شروع کرنے سے پہلے خرچ کی جاتی ہے

q5 (one answer): اگر آپ نے 15 کپ lemonade Rs $30.5$ فی کپ کے حساب سے بیچے تو آپ کی کل earnings کیا ہوگی؟
  options: [0] Rs $457.5$ | [1] Rs $30.5$ | [2] Rs $15$

q6 (one answer): اگر آپ کی کل earnings Rs $105.00$ ہو اور investment کی رقم Rs $40.00$ ہو تو آپ کا profit کیا ہوگا؟
  options: [0] Rs $40.00$ | [1] Rs $65.00$ | [2] Rs $145.00$

For EACH question, list in "correct" EVERY option number that is a correct answer to the question exactly as it is asked — every option a careful teacher would mark right. If two options are both right (for example, the same letters in a different order when the question does not ask about their order), list both. If no option is right, give an empty list. Judge what is written, not what the question-writer probably meant. If you cannot decide without something you were not given (the lesson itself, or a picture you cannot read from its data), set "unsure": true. In "note", say in one short line why — for a wrong or doubled option, name the fact (for example: "قلم is spelled ق ل م, not ک ل م").

FULLY CORRECT, NEVER THE CLOSEST. An option is correct only if it is a fully correct answer to the question exactly as asked — the right word form, tense, spelling, unit and number.
